fluff.overview:
Taurian infantry reflect the Concordat's citizen-soldier tradition, with national service requirements ensuring that most adults have received basic military training before ever donning a uniform. Jump platoons provide the vertical mobility that Taurian garrison commanders prize for defending the rough terrain and broken ground found on many Concordat border worlds. Their ability to bypass obstacles and seize elevated positions gives them a tactical advantage over standard foot infantry.

Support elements carry man-portable short-range missile launchers firing the same warheads used by BattleMechs and combat vehicles, giving the platoon a potent anti-armor punch at close range.
